comment: Easiest professor I've ever had. All you need is to do her 6 homework's, 2 community service things, and get an 85/115 in total for her learning checks. Just read her textbook and take notes in class if you want and you'll get an A. The reading isn't even that long and she provides you with questions for the learning checks at the end of each class

This is a fun class.  Part of each class session is a lecture that focuses on current events and the rest is activities like role playing games and mapping exercises and debates.  You get credit for going to community engagement events.  The professor is very knowledgeable and really cares about students.

Dr. Jacobsen is a very knowledgeable woman who seems to enjoy teaching others.  She is always prepared with her slides. This class is one of the most interesting classes I've taken. I enjoyed reading the assigned textbook and activities/assignments she had for the class. Not an engaging class, tho she lectures the entire time.

This class was very interesting and informative, and it strengthened my ability to think critically and consider the global implications of my actions.  Those perspectives will be useful to me in my future career in medicine or healthcare business.

dr. j really wants students to succeed in her class and gives multiple attempts on homework assignments as long as they're submitted on time. the textbook that is required for the class is written by herself, but i honestly got by fine barely reading it.

The content for this class was not overly difficult, but the way she presented it was confusing. Majority of  the content I learned in this class I was taught by reading the textbook and not in lecture. She gives a 5 question pop quiz at the beginning of every class based on the textbook reading and the wording is usually made to trick you.

I loved this Global Health class! It was well organized and had a lot of in-class activities that made the material super engaging and relevant. The professor knows a lot and even wrote the textbook, which helped everything make sense. It wasn't hard to get a good grade if you kept up with the work. Highly recommend!

While she's very knowledgeable about the subject, her grading scale is nonsense. I got As on both exams and yet still got a B+ in the class. The content seems easy but in the daily quizzes she will ask the most niche questions from the textbook. There are only 5 questions in the daily quiz so if you get one wrong it is an 80. Lecture focused class.

I loved Dr. Jacobsen! She is SO passionate about global health and is very distinguished in the field. The class was super interesting. There are 5-question multiple choice “learning checks” every class based on the previous classes' topic  but they really aren't that bad if you pay attention and do the corresponding reading. Highly recommend!

I'm really glad I took Senior Seminar with Professor Jacobsen. I was super nervous about writing a capstone paper, but she broke it into smaller chunks that were totally manageable, so it never felt overwhelming. She was totally supportive the whole semester.  I highly recommend her if you're feeling anxious about the class.

Very interesting course, and Dr. Jacobsen is very qualified and accomplished in the realm of global health. She knows what she is talking about, which makes the lectures easy to follow and enjoyable. I'm ngl, the quizzes can be pretty specific sometimes, but she drops the lowest 3 from your grade. Easy class, read closely & submit stuff on time.
Awesome professor, great class.  Every day there is a short lecture and some discussion questions and then a different activity, like a role playing game or risk mapping or a debate.  It was fun.

Dr. Jacobsen is passionate about the material she teaches. Overall, I found this class enjoyable. She's strict on late work but she will give you good feedback on your assignments, she even let me resubmit an assignment for a better grade. Her quizzes can be specific but she's understanding and if you talk to her she will do her best to help you.
Horrible professor in my opinion. Class itself is very  easy but not with her.

Those five-question quizzes were horrible, extremely specific, and often tricky, which left me feeling like my mind was being played with every time I took one. Even when I had read the chapters, the quizzes made me doubt myself. She was a sweet lady, but the quizzes just didn't work for me and unfortunately, the tests followed the same pattern.

I'm pre-med, HS minor, and this class was a fun break from science classes. We did a lot of comparisons of health in different places, and the Sustainable Development Goals. You have to read every day, but if you do that and come to class it's easy to get a good grade. I recommend any course taught by Professor Jacobsen.

Global health is not just about pandemics or improving health in low income countries. It is about globalization and so much more. There's a different topic and a different activity every day in class, and there's a reading guide for each chapter in the textbook. My favorite class this semester. Dr. J is awesome!

She wrote the textbook, so expects students to know absurd amount of information. Each class you have a 5 question quiz which all makes up 25% of your grade. Questions are often super specific and try to trick you with one word/term off that makes the statment false or something like that. Not too much work at all. Tests questions are specific.

Class begins with a short 5 question quiz that is no problem if you read the textbook and listen in class. Mainly a lecture-based class and she definitely knows what she is talking about. I personally liked her sense of humor and I enjoyed this class!

Dr. Jacobsen is nice but expects too much from this class. Each class starts with a 5 question learning check based on long HW readings that we don't every fully cover in class. The questions are very specific and often tricky. The assignments and tests aren't hard, but the reading checks kill any love I might have had for this class.

Dr. Jacobsen was a very nice professor and you could tell she is very passionate about the content. The class is easy to do well in if you just complete all the assignments on time and put in the effort. She is also easily accessible through email if you have any questions about the assignments.
